notes.title: Carnival demo update!
notes.notes:
To celebrate SPOOKY SEASON and Carnival being featured in the Steam Next Fest, the demo has been updated with some new puzzles, VGA close ups, and the first part of the fantastic original score by Bernardo Uzeda.

Carnival is an atmospheric folk horror point-&-click featuring low-resolution pixel art graphics, locations drawn from Venice itself, and developing relationships with NPCs, allowing the player to influence events in the game and achieve multiple different endings. 

And while you're downloading the demo, why not give the game a cheeky wishlist?

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2928770/Carnival/

notes.title: Bug fixes
notes.notes:
Bug fixes - thank you Arglschuffni and Nanako

- Now includes messages for unhandled events
- An item location now more obvious
- Fixed issue where if the menu was displayed by pressing escape in a location, the character would only be able to walk using hotspots.
- Fixed some spelling mistakes
- Fixed an item reappearing 

Also added overdue credit to Dark Fantasy Studio for the great music :)

notes.title: Small hotfix

notes.title: Bug fixes - 03.11.2023
notes.notes:
Several bugs fixed (I've tried not to give away spoliers) - some of these may not take effect until a new playthrough is started:

- being able to re-enter the tattoo parlour following the choleric option
- Stanhope checking on Luna when she isn't there
- Being able to move around in the attic when you shouldn't be able to!
- The inventory not displaying the names of items when the mouse is over them
- Some empty descriptions
- Some missing interactions

Thank you to Cat and Baomai1411 for their help with finding these issues :)
